summary: Runtime-neutral transactional outbox dispatch app seam over claimed protocol outbox rows.
claim_boundary: Runtime-neutral dispatch seam only. This slice maps already-claimed outbox rows into dynamic broker publish and gRPC unary transport plans, validates table/tenant/service/event metadata, runs an injected recording executor, and recommends Published only after transport invariant checks pass. It does not run a background poller, publish to a live broker, call a live gRPC server, mark SQL rows, retry failures, dead-letter rows, or prove delivery guarantees/SLOs.
architecture_note: Reusable PendingOutboxEvent, OutboxClaimBatch, OutboxDispatchState, and OutboxMutationReport types now live in the transactional outbox kernel. The SQLx adapter re-exports them for compatibility, while the dispatch app depends only on the kernel and therefore stays SQLx-free.

facets.F1_simplicity: A small dispatch app maps claimed outbox metadata to transport plans and a recording executor trait instead of introducing a broker SDK, gRPC client, scheduler, or async worker loop in this slice.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The seam prepares horizontally scalable publisher workers by separating queue claim, dispatch planning, transport execution, and SQL state mutation boundaries while preserving tenant/audit/policy/idempotency metadata end to end.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover event table drift, tenant drift, event-id drift, service-id drift, missing audit metadata, zero deadline, payload-budget overrun, transport invariant drift, deterministic ack refs, and Published recommendation only after executor success.
facets.F5_quality: Focused outbox kernel/SQLx adapter/dispatch app tests plus the 38-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The dispatch app uses metadata already persisted by the outbox command seam, validates tenant/audit/policy/idempotency fields before dispatch, and adds no payload bodies or raw message/mail/post content.
facets.F11_observability: OutboxTransportAck and OutboxDispatchBatchReport expose deterministic sequence, broker/gRPC ack refs, tenant, audit, policy, idempotency, worker, event IDs, and recommended state for future publisher telemetry correlation.
